notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
